The 5-Step Academic Rubric (PUSC 30 e Lode)

Strict methodology for constructing written essays and oral viva answers.

Step 1: Status Quaestionis & Historical Horizon

Define the exact historical-critical problem, epistolary situation, and polemical target.

Step 2: Scriptural Roots & Greek Morphology

Anchor arguments in exact Greek roots (e.g. dikaiosynē theou, hilastērion, morphē theou) and Septuagint antecedents.

Step 3: Patristic Svolta & Scholastic Distinctions

Contrast classic Catholic hermeneutics with Protestant sola fide and New Perspective interpretations.

Step 4: Thomistic Metaphysical Rigour

Integrate St Thomas Aquinas's commentary (Super Epistolas S. Pauli), distinguishing formal causes from effective grace.

Step 5: Christocentric Synthesis & Pastoral Horizon

Resolve the question into personal conformation to Christ (Gal 2:20) and ecclesial communion.

Primary & Supplementary Manuals

📚
⭐ Primary Manual 12 Chapters

Paolo di Tarso e il suo epistolario

Rev. Prof. Giuseppe De Virgilio (EDUSC, Roma 2021)

Comprehensive institutional textbook: historical chronology, epistolography, seven theological themes, and corpus commentary.

📖 Exegetical Studies 15 Studies

L'epistolario paolino: Studi di esegesi

Rev. Prof. Giuseppe De Virgilio (ISSRA 3, EDUSC 2025)

Specialised research volume with deep-dive structural analyses on the central examination pericopes.

📜 Official Handout 23 Sections

Sussidio Didattico: 21 Pericopes

Prof. Giuseppe De Virgilio (PUSC A.A. 2026-2027)

The official exam dossier with Greek pericopes, lexical tables, and theological dimensions used during viva preparation.

🌍 Supplementary Manual 9 Chapters

An Introduction to the Study of Paul

David G. Horrell (T&T Clark, 3rd ed.)

Standard English critical introduction: historical-critical context, ancient rhetoric, law, and social world.

🇮🇹 Supplementary Manual 3 Syntheses

Lettere Paoline e Altre Lettere (Logos 6)

Alessandro Sacchi, Rinaldo Fabris e Collaboratori (Elledici, Leumann 1996)

Standard Italian theological manual providing extensive doctrinal syntheses, chronological guides, and seventeen master exegetical essays.
